lead: In every `-p nvs-server` accept-loop test the drain has begun before the connection's isolate runs a line, so anything keyed off `Draining::is_draining()` fires on its first wait.
body: `serve_on_this_core`'s `keep_serving` is `|| ControlFlow::Break(())` in all of them, so the loop breaks and calls `draining.begin()` before the child it spawned has run. Make the drain cap the wait with a period and the close what the timeout becomes.
